content:
sara: Heads-up: during koiro-v1 int4 bring-up we hit odd detok regressions on vertical Korean+Han testset + mixed Arabic annotations. BLEU fell from 29.4 (fp16) -> 24.0 (int4). Also numerous ZWJ emoji breaks and RTL-paren flips.

ken: yikes. paste eval cmd + a raw failing example?

sara: ran on ci-evals: 
```
python tools/eval_translate.py --model=koiro-v1:quant=int4 --testset=data/vert_kr_han_ar_mixed.jsonl --metrics=bleu,chrf --batch=40
```
raw: koiro-int4 BLEU=24.0 chrF=40.2 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=29.4 chrF=46.7. dev-bot: diff BLEU=-5.4 (p<0.001).

mei: show minimal pair + detok output please. tokenization shift or detok order?

sara: example below (src / ref / koiro-int4):
src: "\uac00\uac01\u30fb\u6f22\u5b57 (\u0627) \ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u2764\ufe0f"
ref: "\uac00\uac01\u30fb\u6f22\u5b57 (\u0627) \ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u2764\ufe0f\u53c2\u8003"
koiro-int4: "\uac00\uac01\u30fb\u6f22\u5b57 \u0627) \ud83d\ude0a \ufe0f\u200d\u2764\u53c2"
issues: missing opening paren on Arabic fragment, emoji ZWJ sequence split (heart modifier separated), trailing reference token moved and truncated.

ken: hmm looks like subtoken merge / suffix attachment got reordered during detok, maybe because we apply kv-cache prefix trimming before grapheme-aware stitch. Did the tokenizer change?

sara: token_map same as fp16. The int4 runtime applies an aggressive "subtoken coalesce" pass to reduce logits work and we also do an early kv-cache window trim. Suspect ordering bug: coalesce -> kv-trim -> bidi/detok instead of coalesce -> bidi/detok -> kv-trim.

mei: can you run two quick variants: A) int4 + coalesce-off, B) int4 + reorder detok after bidi (force detok last). small sample run is enough. I'll grep for ZWJ handling in detok code path.

sara: done, queued on bench-mini. queued jobs: 3501234680-A, 3501234682-B. QA: please keep an eye on emoji ZWJ sequences and parentheses around RTL spans.

qa: smoke results (subset): variant A BLEU=27.9, variant B BLEU=29.1. variant B recovers most of gap.

ken: that's strong signal that detok ordering matters. if B recovers, we should gate the coalesce reorder or move detok after bidi reordering. Need a patch + small canary.

mei: I'll open a PR to reorder detok step and add unit tests for ZWJ sequences, RTL parentheses, and vertical linewrap cases. sara: can you add 20 human-inspect samples to ci/regress/vert_kr_han_ar_manual.jsonl?

sara: done (PR #4018). marking this P1 for koiro-v1 onboarding; escalate to P0 if any production model shows similar delta. :eyes:

(END)
